The Blue Devils were led by 36th year head coach and [[List of coaches in the Naismith Memorial Basketball Hall of Fame|Hall of Fame member]] [[Mike Krzyzewski]]. The team played its home games at [[Cameron Indoor Stadium]] in [[Durham, North Carolina]] as members of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]]. They finished the season 25–11, 11–7 in ACC play to finish in a tie for fifth place. They defeated [[2015–16 NC State Wolfpack men's basketball team|NC State]] in the second round of the [[2016 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]] to advance to the quarterfinals where they lost to [[2015–16 Notre Dame Fighting Irish men's basketball team|Notre Dame]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2016 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they defeated [[2015–16 UNC Wilmington Seahawks men's basketball team|UNC Wilmington]] and [[2015–16 Yale Bulldogs men's basketball team|Yale]] to advance to the Sweet Sixteen where they lost to [[2015–16 Oregon Ducks men's basketball team|Oregon]]. ==Off season== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
